stemMd: A university proposes leaving some grass areas unmown during spring to support pollinators. It argues that these areas will provide food missing from regularly cut lawns. Which fact most strengthens the argument?

options.label: B
options.textMd: Grass grows faster after some rains.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Some students prefer short grass aesthetically.

options.label: E
options.textMd: The unmown areas contain flowering plants used by local pollinators during a period when few other campus flowers are available.

explanationMd: The finding links the intervention to both suitable food and a seasonal shortage, directly supporting the stated mechanism rather than merely a general association.

distractorRationale.c: Access arrangements do not establish the proposed food benefit.
distractorRationale.a: Equipment ownership does not establish food availability.
distractorRationale.d: Aesthetic preference does not support the ecological mechanism.
distractorRationale.b: Growth rate alone does not identify pollinator food.
